review_notes: [v2] Compared every item with the page preview and four 200-dpi crops of the reference columns (left [5]-[11], [12]-[24]; right [25]-[32], [33]-[41]), with reference.bib as an aid. All 37 entries [5]-[41] were compared character by character with the crops. Each entry is one text item in printed style '[n] ...' (the extractor's leading '- ' removed), venue/book titles in italics as *...*. Reading order fixed: entry [24] (bottom of the left column) had been extracted last; it now follows [23], so the order is [5]-[24] (left column) then [25]-[41] (right column); no entry crosses a column or page boundary. Repairs: diaeresis glyphs 'H¨onig' -> 'Hönig' ([8]), 'M¨uller' -> 'Müller' ([14], [17]); line-wrap compound hyphens restored where real (bib and print agree): 'Neural-swarm2' ([8]), 'Soft actor-critic' ([29]), 'Thirty-seventh' ([35]); URLs split by the line break rejoined without spaces: [7] https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:675041, [13] https://doi.org/10.1023/A:1010091220143, [16] https://openreview.net/forum?id=St1giarCHLP, [21] https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2504.08661, [22] https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:253255370, [27] https://openreview.net/forum?id=F07ic7huE3, [29] https://proceedings.mlr.press/v80/haarnoja18b.html (all identical to the url fields in reference.bib). Kept as printed: '——,' (same authors as [11]) in [12], 'p. 325–345', 'p. 127–190', 'p. I–387–I–395', 'p. 1057–1063' (single p.), lower-case 'mpc', 'cma-es', 'Curl', 'A-td3', 'l1-regularized', 'FreiburgimBreisgau' (no spaces in print and in the bib), 'algorithms.” CoRR' with the full stop inside the quotes in [37], '128 077–128 089' (thin spaces printed as spaces). check finds all 172 lines; the only number difference is the rejoined DOI in [21] (adjudication note).
